title: Payoff Operations Desk Notes: Lien and Lease Payoffs on Trade-In Agreements
content:
Kestrel pays off a lien or lease on a vehicle traded under **Trade-In Agreements** directly to the lienholder.

### Quotes

A payoff quote is recorded only after Kestrel has confirmed it directly with the lienholder when verification is required; the customer's own account screenshot or statement is not a payoff quote.

### Status

The payoff is sent only on an agreement whose status is picked up, as Kestrel's agreement record shows it.

### Age of the quote relied on

The payoff relies on a quote whose age, counted from the quote date, is no more than the payoff quote max age on the send date. Quote age is counted in calendar days from the quote date as day 0; a quote whose age on the send date is greater than the maximum must be replaced by a new confirmed quote before anything is sent. The quote date is the date of the recorded quote entry relied on.

| Quote age on the send date, with the grade's maximum written as M | May the quote be relied on? |
|---|---|
| Day M | Yes; equal to the maximum is not greater than it |
| Day M plus one | No; a new confirmed quote replaces it first |

*Hypothetical example:* with M of 10, a quote dated the 1st may be relied on for a payoff sent on the 11th, but not for one sent on the 12th.

### Negative equity

When negative equity must be cleared first, the payoff is sent only after the shortfall has been covered under the negative equity rule of Trade-In Agreements.

### One payoff

Each agreement has one lien payoff; any overpayment the lienholder returns goes from the lienholder to the customer. A second payoff on an agreement whose history already shows a lien payoff entry is not sent.

### Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of these notes are **no longer in force** and are superseded by the current basis of the payoff charge:

- "The amount sent is the quote amount when sent on or before the quote's good-through date, and otherwise the quote amount plus the quote's per-diem amount for each calendar day after the good-through date through the send date."
- "When the payoff is sent later than the grade's payoff send business days after pickup and the late per-diem switch is true, the per diem for the days beyond Kestrel's own deadline is borne by Kestrel and is not charged against the trade equity."

### Points of judgement

| Situation | Under these notes |
|---|---|
| Customer offers a screenshot of the loan balance | Not a payoff quote |
| Agreement still accepted, vehicle not yet collected | Payoff is not sent |
| Lienholder refunds an overpayment | The refund goes from the lienholder to the customer |

superseded_clauses: The amount sent is the quote amount when sent on or before the quote's good-through date, and otherwise the quote amount plus the quote's per-diem amount for each calendar day after the good-through date through the send date.

When the payoff is sent later than the grade's payoff send business days after pickup and the late per-diem switch is true, the per diem for the days beyond Kestrel's own deadline is borne by Kestrel and is not charged against the trade equity.
